title: RCS CTF 24
description: RCSCTF24 aims to bring together cybersecurity enthusiasts, professionals, and students for an immersive 24-hour offline competition. The event serves as a platform for knowledge exchange, skill development, and fostering collaboration within the cybersecurity community.
prizes:
- Event goodies worth 1 lakhs (INR)
- Exam Vouchers  for winners
- Participation Certificates for all
